class View:
    def __init__(self):
        self.rows = []
        self.notes = {}          # job_id -> note
        self.loading = False
        self.error = None        # loading error
        self.seq = 0             # monotonic request id
        self.current_id = None   # id of latest begun request
        self.last_rows = []       # rows from that request (to preserve)
    
    def begin(self, query):
        """Return monotonic request id."""
        self.seq += 1
        self.current_id = self.seq
        self.loading = False
        self.error = None
        self.rows = []          # clear rows; loading is now True implicitly
        # no request rows yet; rows will be filled in finish
        return self.current_id
    
    def finish(self, request_id, rows):
        """request_id is the id from begin.
           rows is a list (copy) of row data; may be empty.
           Return True if this is the latest valid request, False otherwise.
        """
        # Only the latest begun request can update rows, once.
        if request_id != self.current_id:
            return False            # duplicate or stale reply
        if request_id == self.seq - 1:  # first finish (immediate) or maybe same seq
            self.loading = False
            self.rows = rows          # preserve rows from this request
            # copy notes if present? notes are preserved per job_id, not per row.
            return True
        else:
            # previous request still active; finish returns False
            return False
    
    def load_state(self):
        """Expose loading boolean."""
        return self.loading
    
    def copy_rows(self):
        """Copy current rows; older or duplicate replies return False."""
        # For copying, just return a shallow copy of rows list.
        # This is for external copy; view itself copies when finish sets rows.
        return self.rows.copy()
    
    def note(self, job_id, note):
        """Preserve notes (job_id -> note) through all requests."""
        self.notes[job_id] = note
